column1: # Finnish (fi) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id: wins over the English text for that menu item
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); Finnish has the same two
#                                 forms, with the partitive singular after any number but 1
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Finnish computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied, and no other catalog was used as a source; add
# entries the same way. AI-assisted (Claude Code); not yet proofread line by line.
# Labels use sentence case. Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, OCR, JavaScript ...)
# stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept. Calendar headings use the
# nominative month (`Lokakuu 2026`); dates use the partitive (`14. lokakuuta 2026`).
